ShortDescription.Value: Better Transit Boarding. Late passengers stop holding up vehicles, and cims can RUN earlier to catch Buses, Trams, Trains, and Subways.

Publish.LongDescription:
#### Late Passengers stop holding up transit
- Like Japanese oshiya 👨‍✈️ pushers, but in a mod 😊
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
The game can keep transit stuck waiting long past departure time — even when the cim is far away!
Vanilla only releases a stuck vehicle after ~10 in-game minutes.
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
**Better Boarding steps in sooner so late passengers don't keep everyone waiting and transit keeps moving.**
### 🏃‍➡️🏃‍♀️‍➡️🏃‍♂️‍➡️ 🚍 More Boarding
- ✅ **Skip Late Passengers** — cims who still aren't ready after known departure time can miss that vehicle instead of holding it up. Groups/families are handled too. - ✅ **Cims Run Sooner** — assigned passengers start running before vanilla normally tells them to. - ✅ **Helps long train platforms** — cims hanging around far from the doors get a head start instead of waiting until departure time to start running (vanilla behavior). - ✅ **Adjust Boarding/Loading** — shorten planned dwell/loading times from 1x vanilla up to 5x. - Late cims aren't deleted; the game can naturally continue or reroute them.
Helps reduce long boarding delays, traffic backups, and vehicles bunching up — especially in busy transit cities.
### Notes
- **Compatibility:** don't use Better Boarding and All Aboard together — pick one. - Some players report no issues using Smart Transportation with Better Boarding. - Works nicely with [All Transit + Trucks](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/138390/Windows). - Safe to remove anytime. No Harmony patches and no replacement of the game's transport systems. - Vanilla still controls schedules and un-bunching, so it may intentionally hold a vehicle briefly for spacing.
### Support and feedback
- Support by clicking Like 👍 (top right). No donations requested. - Feedback and PRs welcome through the GitHub and Discord links (icons on the right).
### 15+ Languages
Hello, Bonjour, Hallo, Hola, Ciao, こんにちは, 안녕하세요, Cześć, Oi, Olá, สวัสดี, Merhaba, Привіт, Xin chào, 你好, 哈囉
### How does it work?
Better Boarding leaves vanilla routes, schedules, and un-bunching in control. It mainly fixes citizen behavior that can keep boarding open too long.
**Late passengers / families**
- Late cims get a short grace after departure, then can miss that vehicle instead of holding everyone. - Families/groups are kept together where possible. If the leader is already aboard, a separated child or pet can be instantly placed on the same vehicle so it can leave.
**Cims Run Sooner**
- Vanilla normally waits until departure time before telling an assigned cim to run. - Better Boarding can start them running **512 frames earlier**, especially useful on long platforms. - Works with buses, trains, trams, subways. - Run Sooner itself does not change schedules or departure times.
**Boarding / Loading speed**
- Changes stop/loading time. - `1x` = vanilla, `3x` = recommended, `5x` = shortest dwell. - This is separate from Skip Late and Run Sooner.
### Bonus Status report
Check Options after your city runs for a while to see waiting passengers, worst stops, late passengers skipped, and Run Sooner counts.
**Stats to Log** creates a detailed one-time report with stop names, Entity IDs, line hints, and more. It only runs when clicked.
### Support and Feedback - Easiest way to support is click the LIKE 👍 button (top right). No donations requested. - For Feedback use the GitHub or Discord links (icons on right side of page). PRs are welcome.
### Credits and Thanks
- River-Mochi — mod author - bcallender's All Aboard and Wayze's InstantBoarding — inspiration - yenyang (Anarchy) — code review, feedback, and testing - 🎀 foxxy ✿, MayorCheeks, Empiiey, Neco1996, Gagaxm — testing - elGendo87 — Spanish editor, thumbnail straightener, testing - Thumbnail based on the [Philadelphia train flap board](https://www.inquirer.com/philly/news/20160828_Sign_of_the_times__At_30th_Street_Station__display_board_will_soon_be_no_more.html)
**What does lightweight mean?**
Better Boarding works alongside the game's normal transport systems instead of replacing them. It is designed for low performance impact, even in large cities.
If you got this far, congrats 😄 There is a senryu poem I wrote just for you in the images. Click Like 👍 — it's hard to find, I know, and so tiny.
